# add_props_to_graph { #mofography.compute.add_props_to_graph }

```python
compute.add_props_to_graph(
    G,
    node_props=None,
    node_prop_names=None,
    edge_props=None,
    edge_prop_names=None,
)
```

The function takes in a graph, and a list of node properties and edge properties, and adds them to the graph as node and
edge attributes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type   | Description                                                                             | Default    |
|-----------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| G               |        | the graph                                                                               | _required_ |
| node_props      |        | a list of lists, where each list contains the node properties for a given node property | `None`     |
| node_prop_names |        | list of names of node properties                                                        | `None`     |
| edge_props      |        | a list of lists, where each list contains the edge properties for a given edge property | `None`     |
| edge_prop_names |        | list of strings, names of edge properties                                               | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                            |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A graph with the node and edge properties added to it. |
